rig.skeleton: rigged assets list `skeleton`: bones (`head`) or drone nodes (`origin`) with parent, rest position in glTF axes. Every bone's rest rotation is identity.
rig.limb_bones: the bones a body part (or the prosthetic replacing it) may be skinned to
rig.skinning: each body part (head, torso, arm_l, ...) is one skinned mesh node; every vertex has weight 1.0 on one bone of `limb_bones[part]` (rigid segments). Skinned part nodes have no transform of their own: parts[].joint is the rest joint, not the node origin
rig.prosthetics: prosthetic .glb files carry the adult skeleton and a mesh skinned to the same bones: hide the body's part, move the prosthetic mesh under the body's Skeleton3D (skins bind by bone name)
rig.sockets: sockets[slot].bone is the attachment bone (BoneAttachment3D); identity at rest
rig.clips: one glTF animation per clip, in place (no root motion), 30 fps; `loop` says whether to loop; `events` are seconds from the clip start
